mapper.sql: id, father_id AS fatherId, name, type, ref_id AS refId, link, target, sort, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: insert into fly_guide (id, father_id, name, type, ref_id, link, target, sort, status, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{fatherId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{refId}, #{link}, #{target}, #{sort}, #{status}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update fly_guide set father_id = #{fatherId}, name = #{name}, type = #{type}, ref_id = #{refId}, link = #{link}, target = #{target}, sort = #{sort}, status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from fly_guide where id = #{id} limit 1
select from fly_guide order by father_id asc, sort asc, id asc
select count(*) from fly_guide where father_id = #{fatherId}
mapper.update: update fly_guide set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
